sloka: अष्टौ वर्ष सहस्राणि तेन अस्मिन् ऋषिणा गिरौ ।वसतो मम धर्मज्ञो स्वर् गते तु निशाकरे ॥४-६०-९॥
transliteration: aṣṭau varṣa sahasrāṇi tena asmin ṛṣiṇā girau ।vasato mama dharmajño svar gate tu niśākare ॥4-60-9॥

translations.english: 'O righteous monkeys after the death of sage Nishakara eight thousand years have passed. And I have been living here.
